title: Porchlight features Incorruptible in its May 26 New Releases — 'a bold and urgently needed rethink'
summary: Porchlight Book Company picks Incorruptible as one of four featured new releases for the week of May 26, slotting it between The Art of Thinking, Ecocivilization, and A Time to Gather.
blockquote: From Eric Ries, creator of The Lean Startup, comes a bold and urgently needed rethink of how organizations are built—and why success itself so often turns companies against the people and principles that made them worth building in the first place.
attribution_title: Largest US distributor of business books to corporate buyers
